checks.text: On load, the page shows the heading "Typing Test", the button "Start Test", and the text "No test in progress".
Clicking "Start Test" shows the passage "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", an empty textarea "Input", and the timer reading "00:00".
After "Start Test", filling "Input" with "The quick" shows the text "Correct: 9 / 43".
After "Start Test", filling "Input" with "The quik" shows the text "Correct: 7 / 43".

With the clock paused, after "Start Test", filling "Input" with "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy do", calling `fastForward(45000)` and pressing "g" in "Input" shows "WPM: 12.0", "Accuracy: 100.0%" and the timer "00:45"; after another `fastForward(5000)` the timer still reads "00:45".
After finishing as in A5, clicking "Restart" empties "Input", shows the timer "00:00", the passage "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", and no text "WPM: 12.0".
With the clock paused, after "Start Test", filling "Input" with "The quikc brown fox jumps over the lazy do", calling `fastForward(45000)` and pressing "g" shows "Accuracy: 95.3%" and "WPM: 12.0".

With the clock paused, after "Start Test" and `fastForward(3000)` the timer reads "00:03"; after clicking "Pause" and `fastForward(5000)` it still reads "00:03"; after clicking "Resume" and `fastForward(2000)` it reads "00:05".
Reload keeps the best score: after finishing as in A5 and reloading, the page shows the text "Best WPM: 12.0".
